Key, scoring (flute, viola, cello), movement count and minutes match the Hungaroton disc (Kaczander, all six Op. 12).

note: Gluck Wq. 53 (Nos. 1-6) is listed as mis-attributed in the Gluck-Gesamtausgabe register (via Wikipedia); only No. 3 is in this chunk, so check the other five entries' notes.
